S3 GLACIER FLEXIBLE RETRIEVAL or S3 INTELLIGENT-TIERING ARCHIVE ACCESS
    Bulk:
        - 5-12 hours retrieval
        - costs of $2.50 per TiB
    Standard:
        - 3-5 hours retrieval
        - costs of $10 per TiB
    Expedited:
        - 1-5 minutes retrieval
        - costs of $30 per TiB
